subject: general
question: India's Bhavna Jat, Raveena and Munita Prajapati won the bronze medal with a combined effort in the team category of the women's 20 km race walk event at the World Race Boxing Team Championships 2022 held in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Oman__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• At the **World Race Walking Team Championships 2022**, which were conducted over the weekend **in Muscat, Oman**, three **athletes from India **Tokyo Olympian **Bhawna Jat, Ravina, and Munita Prajapati **joined forces to **win** India a **bronze medal** in the team classification of the women's 20km race walk.
 
• **In the women's 20km **race in **Muscat**, **Ravina finished 14th**, which was the best result for an Indian. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The World Athletics Race Walking Team Championships have been held for** 61 years,** and this is **India's first medal** in that time.
 
• With a** third-place** result **behind China and Greece** and a bronze medal, the Indian team of Bhawna Jat, Ravina, and Munita Prajapati. **Fourth place in the standings went to Lithuania.**
 
• It was the first medal Indian women have ever won at a major race walking competition. **In the 2012 men's 20km,** the Indian trio of KT Irfan, **Surinder Singh**, and Babubhai Kesharabhai Panucha** took home the bronze medal.**
